title: Kimi K3: Latest WEKA AMG vs Internal B300 Mooncake
description: Three-hour AgentX measurements with a twenty-minute trace-idle cap: thirteen latest-WEKA and nine internal-Mooncake runs. Three flagged WEKA measurements remain excluded from the clean frontier.

comparison_notes.baseline_policy: Best measured envelope across four internal serving variants; original configuration identities are retained per run.
comparison_notes.scenario_policy: Separate from one-hour/five-minute-idle scenarios; no published one-hour reference is included.
comparison_notes.cache_policy: Latest WEKA uses 1200 GiB FP8 KDA-tail DRAM with no spill and 8 TiB WEKA attention-KV quota. Internal Mooncake uses 2,248 GiB DRAM over EFA.
comparison_notes.qualification_policy: C128 has metric-integrity flag; C140/C180 have DRAM-recovery flags. All 22 full measurements retained; 19 are clean.
limits: Different images, cache contents, transports and serving adaptations prevent a backend-only causal interpretation.
System-wide idle compression cap of 10 seconds means a trace-idle cap of 1,200 seconds is not guaranteed wall-clock idleness.
